notes:
All 4 points are done; run.sh takes around 2 minutes. On the finding: chords (NOTE_LENGTH=BAR) and ARP (Gate knob 50) now play 100% of the time. But all 16 sounds at the same time never occur in this song, at most 15 (6% of the time). The reason is the short one-shots in the kit (RIM only sounds 10% of the time and never together with SNARE). The output therefore shows a breakdown by the number of sounding sounds.

How the culling is hooked up: getLastRunTimeforCurrentTask() is inline. routine() reads taskManager.list[currentID].durationStats.average (offset from the disassembly) and multiplies by 44100. Before every call, a mean of the emulated run times of the previous routine() calls (instructions / 400 MHz) is written there, updated with (avg + runtime)/2 as in TaskManager::runTask. From this, setDireness() derives cpuDireness.

Names of the sounds: the harness looks for a string pointer near the Sound* and matches it against the names from the XML. It picks the offset that matches most often. All 16 names were resolved.
